question: Why did the NTFS fuzz guest mount a corrupt first file record, and what must mount reject so that row goes green?
allowedInputs: drivers/filesystems/ntfs/fsctl.c and ntfs.h already in this tree
unittests/ntfs/out/share-fuzz-5/result.log. Image 6 was named in the note, and no separate log path was recorded for it.

harness.guest: amd64 live CD, QEMU TCG, fuzz disk
harness.name: Invoke-NtfsSuite.ps1 -Phase fuzz -Count 8

measuredEffect.note: The red score is from the 25-image run that stopped on image 5. The green score is the later run of the eight distinct mutations. All eight guests printed FuzzImage rejected.

note: Image 5 lengthened a resident value past its attribute. Image 6 changed one timestamp byte. Both left $MFTMirr unchanged, and the host checker treats that disagreement as corrupt.
